'''Jack Barbaria''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Denver World Qualifier]] on 30 June 2001 with Shmi's Hut start with Threepio, according to Michael Girard's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2571">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-03-girard-goes-to-denver-6-29-7-1-01d2571/ girard-goes-to-denver-6-29-7-1-01], DeckTech (Michael "Dvader" Girard, 3 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-03-girard-goes-to-denver-6-29-7-1-01d2571/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
